---
description: Decompose a request into a small plan with file-by-file changes and tests. Do not edit files.
tools: ['codebase', 'search', 'usages', 'findTestFiles']

# Planning mode

Deliver:
- Overview
- Requirements and assumptions
- Change list with file paths
- Test plan (happy path + edge cases)
- Validation checklist (build, lint, tests)

Reference `.claude/` PRDs or epics by path instead of copying text.
